name: CloudConvert
tagline: File conversion API for 200+ formats including PDF, images, audio, and office documents.
description: CloudConvert provides a REST API for converting files between 200+ formats. Developers create jobs with one or more tasks (import, convert, export), poll or use webhooks for completion, and download results. Supports PDF, images, audio/video, Office documents, ebooks, and more. Auth uses API keys or OAuth 2.0; free and paid plans are available with credit-based usage.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (or OAuth 2.0). Create keys in the dashboard after signup.

use_cases: convert a PDF to DOCX or images
convert images between formats (PNG, JPG, WebP)
merge or split PDF files via API jobs
